name: Anarlog
description:
Anarlog is a private, local-first AI notetaker for meetings. This connector gives Claude read-only access to the meetings you have chosen to share with Anarlog Cloud: notes, AI summaries, participants, action items, transcripts, and the history of recurring meetings.

Ask Claude to find a meeting by title or date, summarize what was decided, pull the action items you own, compare this week's standup with last week's, quote what someone said from the transcript, or draft a follow-up email grounded in the actual conversation.

How it works: Anarlog records and transcribes on your computer. Nothing reaches the cloud until you enable Cloud API & Connectors in Settings → Developers, which uploads a server-readable snapshot of your meetings. Disabling it deletes the snapshots and revokes connector access. The connector never writes or deletes anything; editing notes stays in the Anarlog app.

Requires an Anarlog Pro account with Cloud API & Connectors enabled. Sign in with your Anarlog account when Claude asks; no API key is needed.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Anarlog to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Anarlog to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.anarlog.so/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Anarlog MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Anarlog provides these MCP tools: export_meeting, get_meeting, get_meeting_transcript, get_recurring_meeting_history, and list_meetings.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Anarlog?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Anarlog in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Anarlog requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Anarlog is developed by Fastrepl, Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
